verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so the product appears to ship scheduling. The evidence is a single category heading with no description of how it works. missing for 10: documentation of recurring vs one-off scheduling options, evidence that tasks run automatically and deliver results back to the user, depth of the feature docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
